extracted.intended_audience: Users of Math.StackExchange seeking help with login, account, posting, or site issues
extracted.subtask_description: Index of common help topics and contact reasons for Math.StackExchange users, guiding them to the appropriate support article or action (login issues, account management, posting problems, feedback, advertising, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Choosing the correct help topic
rubrics_metrics.description: To help us help you, please choose the description below that best matches your reason for contacting us. We've tried to list the most common reasons, along with their solutions - if you can't find one that addresses your problem, select "Other".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the single topic that best matches your issue so you can be routed to the appropriate help article or support path. If none apply, choose 'Other'.

rubrics_metrics.name: OpenID endpoint not found
rubrics_metrics.description: When I try to log in, I receive the error message, "OpenID endpoint not found."

rubrics_metrics.name: Lost password
rubrics_metrics.description: I cannot remember my password to log into the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defunct OpenID provider
rubrics_metrics.description: I have lost access to the OpenID provider I use to log in.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding and removing login credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: I would like to change how I log into Stack Exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete my user profile
rubrics_metrics.description: I would like to withdraw my Stack Exchange account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merge user profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: I have two accounts I would like to join together.

rubrics_metrics.name: Question/Answer denied
rubrics_metrics.description: I am receiving the error, "Sorry we are no longer accepting questions/answers from this account."

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality standards
rubrics_metrics.description: I am receiving the error, "It does not meet our quality standards."

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature requests, bug reports, and ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: I have a suggestion for the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Question closed
rubrics_metrics.description: I do not understand why this question was closed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security vulnerability
rubrics_metrics.description: I have discovered a security vulnerability and would like to contact Stack Exchange privately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertise on Stack Exchange
rubrics_metrics.description: I have a question about advertising on your site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other (issue not listed above)
rubrics_metrics.description: I have a question about a topic not listed above.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you can't find a matching reason, select 'Other'. For many issues you can also ask on the site's meta or search existing help articles and posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ask on our meta site / search first
rubrics_metrics.description: Need help with something else? Ask on our meta site or search for your question below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many site-specific or community questions are answered on the meta site; searching existing posts may resolve your issue without contacting support.
